eye.input: the MI matrix I only (one fermion mode per site); never the adjacency, coordinates or symmetry
eye.pipeline: largest informational piece (I > 1e-10) -> d = -log(I/I0) -> geo_core.geodesic (factor 1.5) -> Gm, diameter D = max Gm
eye.loops: big_core H1 reader UNCHANGED: 220 max-min landmarks, ripser full filtration, loop = H1 bar with persistence/D > 0.4
eye.cavities: ripser H2 on 100 max-min landmarks (<= 150 as asked; 150 too slow, see dev), full filtration, cavity = H2 bar with persistence/D > THR2. THR2 from calibration (below).
eye.cones: h = median nearest-neighbour geodesic distance. For c in (1.5, 2.5): V_x(c) = #{y: Gm(x,y) <= c h} incl. x; rho_x(c) = V_x(c)/median V(c); rho_bar = mean of the two. CONE POINT = rho_x(c) < 0.7 at BOTH scales AND nearest-neighbour distance of x <= 1.2 h AND rho_bar(x) is the smallest in its 2.5 h ball (ties: lowest index). Angle (2-D) = 2 pi rho_bar; solid-angle fraction = rho_bar. Expected: Z3 cone (angle 2pi/3) rho ~ 1/3; 4-D Z2 point rho ~ 1/2; icosphere 5-valent vertex (angle 5/6 * 2pi) ~ 0.83.
eye.balls_on_drawn_shapes: one fermion mode per site hopping on the drawn graph, H = -T, thermal Gaussian state C = 1/(1+exp(beta (H - mu))), beta = 1, mu = 0. Quotients: symmetric (untwisted) sector H_q = Q^T H Q, Q = normalised orbit indicator. Only MI(C) goes to the eye.

calibration.nulls: 4 classes x 10, seeds default_rng(20261040) (fresh, never used): shuffle and noise of the R1 base (24x24 box walker vacuum MI, theta 0.125, w 0.3), random_graph = random 6-regular graph on 576 nodes with the SAME thermal balls as the drawn shapes (pipeline-matched; R1 used 4-regular ground state), random_state = Haar Gaussian state 288/576
calibration.THR2_rule: THR2 = max(0.2, 1.25 * largest rel2 over the 40 calibration nulls). Fixed before any exam null or exam shape is read. Cone thresholds are NOT calibrated (fixed above).

exam_nulls.pass: per class: fraction of instances with cavities >= 1 <= 5 % (<= 1/25) AND fraction with cones >= 1 <= 5 %. Loops (H1) false positives reported, not graded (graded in R1).

T2/Z3.draw: hex torus L = 27, 120 deg rotation, 245 orbits
T2/Z3.pass: cavities == 1 AND loops == 0 AND cones == 3, the 3 cones at hop distance <= 1 (orbit graph, grading only) from 3 DISTINCT fixed orbits, each rho_bar in [0.2, 0.5] (angle 72..180 deg)

T4/Z2.pass: cones == 16 at hop distance <= 1 from 16 distinct fixed orbits, each rho_bar in [0.35, 0.7]; loops == 0
T4/Z2.not_graded: cavities (target b2 = 6). Declared expectation: H2 on 100 landmarks of a 656-site 4-D space cannot resolve the six 2-cycles; H3, H4 out of budget (not computed).

T2_flat.secondary: loops == 2 and cavities == 1 (reported, graded separately as 'torus recognised')

S2.draw: icosphere level 3 (642 sites; 12 five-valent vertices = mild cones of angle 300 deg)

L1.L1_PASS: exam nulls pass AND T2/Z3 pass AND T4/Z2 cone pass AND cones == 0 on both controls
L1.if_fail: report plainly; no re-tuning of thresholds after any exam result
